issues.display_title: Issue #4181: Improve walkthrough map styling across tour levels
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Update the Walkthrough Video map so Walking and Slideshow modes display panorama markers and link lines from every tour level while clearly distinguishing the active level and selected items.

Requirements

  • Display panorama markers and link lines from all levels in both Walking and Slideshow modes.
  • Render active-level items in red at full opacity.
  • Render non-active-level items with the same status color at reduced opacity.
  • Keep panoramas from non-active levels selectable.

Walking mode

  • Render selected panorama markers in blue.
  • Render only consecutive route segments between selected video slides in blue.
  • Keep valid next-step panorama markers green.
  • Preserve the existing connected-panorama selection and latest-item removal rules.
  • Apply reduced opacity to selected or related items when they are outside the active level.

Slideshow mode

  • Render selected panorama markers in blue.
  • Keep all link lines red regardless of selection.
  • Apply reduced opacity to markers and links outside the active level.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Switching levels changes marker and link opacity without hiding items from other levels.
  • A link is considered part of the active level only when both endpoints belong to the active level.
  • Walking route detection works when link endpoint coordinates are reversed.
  • Two selected panoramas that are not consecutive do not produce a blue route segment.
  • Stored walkthrough selections load with the correct blue selected styling.
  • Existing Walking and Slideshow selection limits and interactions remain unchanged.
  • No backend endpoint, request payload, or Redux schema changes are required.
